description: Record actual operator-confirmed usefulness and household delivery status for your completed quote review. Requires your Builder key. Free; never infer feedback from a successful tool call. Inputs: reviewToolCallId (required), operatorConfirmed (required), usefulness (required), findingId (required), deliveredToHousehold (required), action (required). Cost: free; requires a free EnergyAI key. Example: {"reviewToolCallId":"<toolCallId of the review>","operatorConfirmed":true,"usefulness":"useful","findingId":null,"deliveredToHousehold":true,"action":"asked_installer"} [free]

findingId.description: A returned q1–q6 check id, or null when not useful.

operatorConfirmed.description: True only after the operator actually assessed this result.

reviewToolCallId.description: toolCallId of the completed review owned by this key.

name: record_quote_review_outcome
